label: Mutual exclusion
presentDetail: Resource instances are exclusive once allocated, so another process cannot use the same instance at the same time.
absentDetail: No contested resource instances are active in this snapshot.

label: Hold and wait
presentDetail: At least one blocked process is holding resources while requesting more.
waitingWithoutHoldingDetail: Blocked processes are waiting, but none of them are currently holding another resource.
absentDetail: No process is waiting for additional resources right now.

label: No preemption
presentDetail: Allocated resources stay with a process until it finishes unless recovery explicitly intervenes.
absentDetail: No process is currently holding resources, so preemption is not part of the failure.

label: Circular wait
absentDetail: No closed wait cycle was isolated from the blocked set, but the system is still unsafe because no remaining process can satisfy Need <= Work.
